fields.statusHint: Current readiness status recorded for this data source.
fields.uiStateHint: Simplified availability state displayed to users in reports and dashboards.
fields.reasonHint: Explanation when this source is not fully ready or is experimental.
fields.familyHint: Domain group to which this data source belongs.
fields.ownerModuleHint: System module responsible for maintaining this data source.
fields.captureSourceHint: Underlying source key from which events or snapshots are captured.
fields.lagHint: How far behind current time the latest captured data is, alongside the freshness target.
fields.watermarkHint: Timestamp of the most recent data processed for this source.
fields.pinnedWatermarkHint: Watermark held in place when freshness stalls, together with when it was first observed.
fields.coverageStartedHint: Earliest point in time from which historical data coverage is available.
fields.backfillFloorHint: Earliest timestamp reachable by historical backfill for this source.
fields.lastConfirmedHint: Most recent time this data source's status was confirmed.
fields.lastCheckedHint: Most recent time readiness was checked for this source.
fields.statusChangedHint: When this data source last transitioned to its current status.
